property_intelligence.coverage_statement: Shopping centres are the Phase 1 relationship scope; high-street corridors remain Unknown unless explicitly researched.
property_intelligence.portfolio_overlap_note: Portfolio overlap is derived from public tenancy and property-group evidence; it is not proof of a private commercial relationship.

co_tenancy.coverage_statement: Curated key co-tenants only; not a complete directory. Optical rows require accepted canonical place membership. Bailey high-street baseline coverage confirms the corridor and its accepted optical tenants; broader retail-mix research remains separately measurable.

high_street_research.coverage_statement: Baseline research reconciles each Bailey Nelson address and accepted optical membership to a canonical street-and-locality corridor. Broader co-tenancy, visitation and footfall research is measured separately because high streets usually have no single authoritative tenant directory.

intelligence_layer_register.label: Population and demographics
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: ABS Data by Region and Census plus Stats NZ regional boundaries
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Australian SA2 population growth age and equivalised household income are source-year labelled
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: NZ comparable small-area demographics and daytime population still need an official ingestion path

intelligence_layer_register.label: Ownership management and leasing
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Official owner portfolios annual reports filings and leasing pages
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Public roles and portfolio overlap only
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Private contacts deal history rents and lease terms remain outside the public repository

intelligence_layer_register.label: Key co-tenancy profiles
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Official centre directories and owner materials
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Curated anchors and decision-relevant categories rather than exhaustive directories
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Directory gaps and ambiguous brand categories require manual review

intelligence_layer_register.label: Growth and development signals
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Official government project pages planning sources and owner announcements
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Selective verified signals are mapped and early-stage proposals are labelled
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Continuous jurisdiction-wide monitoring and local impact judgement are not yet complete

intelligence_layer_register.label: Centre visitation and scale
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Official owner compendia annual reports and public centre profiles
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Metrics retain property and evidence dates and unknown is explicit
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Many centres do not publish footfall GLA turnover or vacancy

intelligence_layer_register.label: Tourism and visitor demand
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: TRA Tourism Research Australia MBIE and Stats NZ official releases
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: No tourism proxy is currently used in opportunity scoring
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Geographic alignment seasonal interpretation and local visitor counts require design and review

intelligence_layer_register.label: Transport accessibility and traffic
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: State transport open data GTFS station usage and road-count datasets
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: OpenStreetMap amenities are available only as contextual evidence
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Jurisdictions publish inconsistent measures and travel-time catchments require routing infrastructure

intelligence_layer_register.label: Premium and value retail positioning
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Versioned public brand taxonomy applied to evidenced co-tenancy
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Current tenant categories do not yet form a premium-value score
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Brand positioning changes and mixed-format retailers require curator judgement

intelligence_layer_register.label: Consumer spending
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Official household expenditure and regional economic releases where geographically defensible
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: Income is explicitly not presented as spending
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Granular card spend centre turnover and category spend are generally proprietary

intelligence_layer_register.label: Private Bailey performance
intelligence_layer_register.public_automation_path: Authenticated private service or browser-memory-only import
intelligence_layer_register.current_boundary: No raw private performance values are stored in public assets
intelligence_layer_register.manual_or_private_gap: Revenue contribution occupancy cost and deal information require Bailey authorization and private controls
